category: free dynamic DNS and managed DNS

free_tier.stated: 4 hostnames free (third-level names under Dynu domains, or your own domain), no expiry for an unused free account, REST API free for all users

per_object_cap.stated: 4 hostnames and up to 4 subdomains on the free plan per the FAQ; the membership page says members can have more than 3 third level domain names and 200 custom records, and no page read gives a free custom-record count (unverified)

retention.stated: Dynu accounts never expire; a free dynamic DNS service stays fully functional until the user deletes it

egress.terms: no DNS query cap published on the pages read

interface_detail: three update paths: a dyndns2-style HTTP update, GET https://api.dynu.com/nic/update?hostname=HOST&myip=IP&myipv6=IPV6&password=PASSWORD (the password may be sent as is or as an MD5 or SHA256 hash, and a separate IP update password can be set), up to 20 hostnames per request; HTTP and TCP GnuDIP at gnudip.dynu.com; and a REST API at https://api.dynu.com/v2/ with an API-Key header that manages hostnames and DNS records
tooling: the free Dynu IP update clients for Windows, macOS and Linux, ddclient with protocol dyndns2, routers with a Dynu or Custom provider, GnuDIP clients, and curl against the REST API
chaining: a free name that can also carry MX, TXT, SRV and CNAME records and a wildcard, on a Dynu domain or on a domain the user already owns that is served by Dynu name servers

limits.value: 4 hostnames and 4 subdomains free; the membership page's own figure is more than 3 third level domain names for members
up to 20 hostnames in one update request (numhost above 20)
several record types are member-only, among them CAA on a third-level Dynu name and on the user's own domain; A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, SRV, TXT and PTR are free

binding_note: the hostname cap of 4 decides for a free account; the record-type gate matters only for CAA-class records

identity_cost.detail: the sign-up form asks for a first name, a last name, a username, a password and an e-mail address entered twice, or a sign-up with GitHub or Google; no phone or card field in the captured form text (https://www.dynu.com/en-US/ControlPanel/CreateAccount)

reliability_note: a failed update authentication returns HTTP 200 with the body badauth, so a status-only check reports success on a failed update; an unknown domain name can also return badauth
confidence_note: the dynamic DNS page, the FAQ, the membership page, the REST API page and the IP update protocol page were read and quoted; the update endpoint was probed once with a wrong password and answered 200 badauth. The free hostname count is 4 in the FAQ and implied as 3 by the membership page, so the figure is unreconciled
